frame: plane of each rocker's outer side face (work/parts/rocker{L,R}/o_plane.json, as parts/rocker_profile.json): u along the rocker (front positive), v up, mm
method: per-photo orthophotos of each end on the face plane at 0.25 mm per pixel (tools/rocker_ends/ortho.py). trace.py, round 0: the side face grown from points picked by eye in one photo, that outline placed in every photo (slide of up to 10 mm) and snapped to where the colour stops being the face's. Round 1: the photos slid onto each other by round 0, the median over photos of 'unlike the face' taken and its outline used as the seed (marks on the face that reach the edge bridged by hand), placed and snapped again. fit.py: photos slid onto each other (pose error at the chair's ends, two numbers per photo), points dropped where a camera looks onto the neighbouring surface, median over photos. Inputs: tools/rocker_ends/inputs/seeds.json.
caveats: the top edge is the tone edge between the lit top face and the side face; on an eased arris it reads a little below the true top surface, and the bottom silhouette a little above the true underside (radius not measured)
the ends are modelled square across the rocker's width; any rounding in plan view is not modelled
each photo is slid, not turned; where an end sits along the rocker is known to about 1 mm per side (median of the photos' slides)

nose.bridged_by_hand: two marks on the right rocker's face reach its edge and are bridged in the all-photo seed (points in the frame of the all-photo median, +-1 mm): a white scuff across the face at u 587-598 (Joe's IMG_1619 shows it; in the median it cuts 8 mm into the top edge) and finish worn off the end's arris at v 110-120 (a pale band 1-2 mm wide inside the silhouette)

left_right_shape_gap_mm.note: distance between the left and right outlines (each set on the profile), more than 15 mm from the landmark; the design is their average, so each side is half of this from it

tail.provenance: triangulated (one plane per side; left and right averaged); place along and across the rocker: fitted to parts/rocker_profile.json

left_right_shape_gap_mm.note: distance between the left and right outlines (each set on the profile), more than 15 mm from the landmark; the design is their average, so each side is half of this from it

nose.provenance: triangulated (one plane per side; left and right averaged); place along and across the rocker: fitted to parts/rocker_profile.json

design.note: left side-plane frame with the right rocker carried onto the left (parts/rocker_profile.json right_vs_left), i.e. the frame of mean_top / mean_bot. Each side's end was first slid onto mean_top ('set_on_existing_profile': the end's shape is measured, its place is the existing profile's), then left and right were averaged point by point. Each end: 'top' and 'bot' run from blend_u[0] (where they equal the old profile) to the landmark; between blend_u[0] and blend_u[1] old and new are mixed linearly; beyond, the new outline alone. The rocker's outline = mean_top from the tail's blend_u[0] to the nose's blend_u[0], the nose's top to its corner, the nose's bot back, mean_bot, the tail's bot out to the tip, the tail's top back.

as_averaged.note: the two outlines that were averaged, in the design frame (each already slid onto mean_top), from u = -316.0 (tail) / 570.0 (nose) to the landmark
